thread:
maria: Quick sync to lock sprint slice for Optimize pilot. Key AcmeHealth asks: adaptive batching hints, simple quant fallback, eval-triggered alerts. can we produce a minimal acceptance checklist now?
chen: We can. Tradeoff summary: p99 latency vs token cost. Recommend two pilot modes: 
- latency-mode: conservative batching (KV cache only), tight SLOs
- cost-mode: aggressive batching + optional 8-bit quant qfallback
oliver: Important: quant fallback MUST be opt-in per-customer during pilot, and only triggered by regression signals, not as global default. customers dislike quality surprises.
sam: Proposed eval-alert rule: "concordance drop >6% over the last 10k evalged requests". Debounce with 30m mute window and noisy alert aggregation.
maria: Rollout plan sketch: canary to 5% traffic -> 20% -> 100% over 48h with telemetry checks at each step + automatic rollback to pinned variant if quality regresses. ops must get prompt-level examples when alert fires.
chen: Ops question: do we require Dedicated GPU pool for canary? If hosted, routing must allow fallback to a compatible model variant. eng-bot: Canary automation check: canary-policy v2 flag missing in prod.
oliver: Acceptance checklist (draft):
1) Console policy UI: basic toggles for batching window and cache + an "advanced" YAML editor.
2) Batching heuristic: moving-average seq estimator (1k sample window) + static presets fallback.
3) Quant fallback path implemented with smoke tests against evaluation harness.
4) Eval-alert pipeline integrated with SLO dashboard + alerts to #eng-oncall.
5) Canary rollout automation with rollback hook and telemetry gating.
maria: Performance gates for MVP:
- latency-mode: end-to-end p50 <= 120ms, p99 <= 450ms
- cost-mode: >=15% token-cost reduction on our bench corpus, no >3% concordance drop on eval set
sam: Also add manual mute + throttling for eval alerts; weekly digest to stakeholders, urgent pings to oncall. i'll own the thresholds and alert templates.
chen: Batching policy proto (example):
```yaml
batching_policy:
  mode: adaptive
  estimator:
    type: moving_avg_seq
    window: 1000
  window_ms:
    min: 5
    max: 60
  conservative_override: false
```
maria: UX ask from AcmeHealth: one-click "Apply recommendations" that previews estimated $ saved and p99 impact. For MVP we can show placeholder numbers and then wire live calc in follow-up.
oliver: UX minimal: modal with 3 bullets + estimated savings. engineering can ship placeholder values first.
chen: Timeline proposal: core engine + eval-alert plumbing in 2-week sprint, console + canary automation follow-up in 1 week. If estimator blocks, fallback to static presets (mobile/desktop/high-throughput).
maria: Agreed. Action owners: @chen prototype estimator, @oliver quant fallback smoke tests, @sam eval-alert spec + templates, @maria coordinate canary plan with ops. I'll schedule a 30m demo Thu. :thumbsup:
